H2-02.title: R24 · Gauge workshop

checkpoints.zh: 看清打开柜内的参照格

checkpoints.en: Match blocks to the drawing fixtures
checkpoints.zh: 依据工程图完成形体夹具

checkpoints.en: Set the chest dials from gauge readings
checkpoints.zh: 依据压力表读数调整箱锁

checkpoints.en: Restore and turn the belt drive
checkpoints.zh: 装回皮带传动并正确驱动

checkpoints.en: Fit the belt to the pulleys
Fit the crank to the input shaft
Unlock the exit with the obtained code
checkpoints.zh: 用实际获得的密码解锁出口

observations.zh: 看清打开柜内的参照格

text.en: The exit lock has released; the door can be opened.
text.zh: 出口锁已释放，门还可以打开。

text.en: Compare each block with the different views in the engineering drawing before choosing a fixture socket.
text.zh: 先比较形体与工程图中的不同视图，再选择夹具孔位。

text.en: The completed fixture releases the engineering drawing cabinet.
text.zh: 夹具完成后，工程图柜已释放。

text.en: The released cabinet contains the hand crank and the next mechanical reference.
text.zh: 释放后的柜子里有摇柄和下一段传动的参照。

text.en: Read each pressure gauge against its own ticks, including the tilted faces, before matching the corresponding chest dial.
text.zh: 先相对各压力表自身刻度读数，包括倾斜的表面，再设置对应箱锁旋钮。

text.en: The gauge settings release the chest lid.
text.zh: 压力表对应的设置已释放箱盖。

text.en: The opened chest contains the rubber belt for the empty pulley pair.
text.zh: 打开的箱子里有与空滑轮组相配的橡胶皮带。

text.en: The belt guide drawings show how crossing a belt changes the driven direction; compare those arrows with the punched locator sheet.
text.zh: 皮带示意图显示交叉安装如何改变输出方向；把这些箭头与打孔定位片对应。

text.en: The completed drive releases the reading cabinet door.
text.zh: 传动完成后，读数柜门已释放。

text.en: Compare the coloured corner marks on the punched locator sheet and digit plate, then follow the indicated hole order.
text.zh: 比较打孔定位片与数字板的彩色角标，再依照标出的孔位顺序读取。

H2-03.title: R25 · Tea samples

checkpoints.zh: 看清茶叶罐目录图的朝向

checkpoints.en: Inspect the numbered cups in the opened store
checkpoints.zh: 看清打开储物柜内的杯具及对应数字

checkpoints.en: Use the key on the cup-store lock
Unlock the exit with the obtained code
checkpoints.zh: 用实际获得的密码解锁出口

observations.zh: 看清茶叶罐目录图的朝向

observations.en: Inspect the numbered cups in the opened store
observations.zh: 看清打开储物柜内的杯具及对应数字

text.en: The exit lock has released; the door can be opened.
text.zh: 出口锁已释放，门还可以打开。

text.en: The marks continue across the lid rings; compare the joins between neighbouring rings.
text.zh: 图案跨越相邻图环，比较每一处衔接。

text.en: The aligned rings release the canister lid.
text.zh: 图环对齐后，罐盖已释放。

text.en: The tray photograph identifies cups by their shape and handle; compare its viewing direction with the real tray.
text.zh: 托盘照片用杯形和把手区分物件；比较照片视角与实际托盘。

text.en: The reconstructed tray releases the tasting-card box.
text.zh: 托盘还原后，品评卡盒已释放。

text.en: The correctly oriented tea caddy releases its plinth compartment, which holds a brass key with a cup-shaped tag.
text.zh: 茶叶罐朝向正确后，底座隔间已释放，里面有带杯形标签的黄铜钥匙。

text.en: The cup-tag key matches the lock plate on the cup-store cabinet.
text.zh: 杯形标签钥匙与杯具柜锁牌相配。

text.en: The released cup-store door can be opened to expose the catalog picture.
text.zh: 已释放的杯具柜门可以打开，露出内部目录图。

text.en: Compare the tasting-card marks with the tea caddy while changing its orientation with the two buttons.
text.zh: 用两个按钮改变茶叶罐的朝向，同时比较品评卡上的标记。

text.en: The tasting card gives a cup order; compare those cups with the numbers inside the opened cup-store cabinet.
text.zh: 品评卡给出杯具顺序，把这些杯具与打开的杯具柜内数字对应。

H2-04.title: R26 · Archive index

checkpoints.en: Inspect the necessary torn page strips
checkpoints.zh: 看清必要的撕裂书页片
找到照片对应的目录抽屉

checkpoints.en: Unlock the exit with the obtained code
checkpoints.zh: 用实际获得的密码解锁出口

observations.en: Inspect the necessary torn page strips
observations.zh: 看清必要的撕裂书页片

text.en: The exit lock has released; the door can be opened.
text.zh: 出口锁已释放，门还可以打开。

text.en: Use the cabinet photograph to locate its matching catalog drawer by row and column.
text.zh: 依据柜子照片中的行列位置，找到对应目录抽屉。

text.en: The drawer matched to the turned photograph contains a torn strip; compare it with the loose strips on the shelves.
text.zh: 与旋转照片匹配的抽屉里有一张撕裂片，把它与架上散放的书页片比较。

text.en: Compare the torn edges and printed line continuations before placing the page strips in the repair slots.
text.zh: 先比较撕裂边缘与印刷线条的延续，再把书页片放入修复槽。

text.en: The reconstructed page and index grid provide the reference for the seal dials.
text.zh: 修复后的书页与索引格共同提供封印旋钮的参照。

text.en: The matched seal dials release the archive cabinet door.
text.zh: 封印旋钮匹配后，档案柜门已释放。

text.en: The repaired page's animal-and-mark pairs correspond to the grid inside the opened archive cabinet.
text.zh: 修复页上的动物—标记配对与打开的档案柜内索引格对应。

H2-04.evidence_rules: Only actual game state/events and qualified frames delivered to the model; no standard-solution-order requirement or inferred unread clue.

H2-05.title: R27 · Mirror service

checkpoints.en: Inspect the clear aligned viewing window
checkpoints.zh: 看清清晰且对齐的观察窗

checkpoints.en: Clear the viewing window with the pump
Seal the vent with its stopper
Unlock the exit with the obtained code
checkpoints.zh: 用实际获得的密码解锁出口

observations.en: Inspect the clear aligned viewing window
observations.zh: 看清清晰且对齐的观察窗

text.en: The exit lock has released; the door can be opened.
text.zh: 出口锁已释放，门还可以打开。

text.en: Follow the beam across the small mirrors toward the destination shown on the board.
text.zh: 沿小镜片追踪光束，直到光路板标出的终点。

text.en: The completed beam route releases the optics-case door.
text.zh: 反射光路完成后，光学工具柜门已释放。

text.en: The opened optics case contains the hand pump and punched locator plate.
text.zh: 打开的光学工具柜里有手动气泵和打孔定位板。

text.en: The round rubber stopper on the side shelf matches the vent hole on the viewing box.
text.zh: 侧架上的圆橡胶塞与观察盒上的通气孔相配。

text.en: The round stopper and pump hose match different openings on the viewing box; compare their shapes before operating the pump handle.
text.zh: 圆塞和气泵接口对应观察盒上的不同开口；先比较形状，再操作泵柄。

text.en: Compare the clear window with the punched locator plate while changing the mirror tilt.
text.zh: 调整镜面倾角时，把清晰观察窗与打孔定位板对应起来。

text.en: The clear mirror view reverses the digit board; compare its reference marks with the punched locator plate.
text.zh: 清晰的镜面视图会左右反转数字板；把其中参照标记与打孔定位板对应。

H2-05.evidence_rules: Only actual game state/events and qualified frames delivered to the model; no standard-solution-order requirement or inferred unread clue.

H2-06.title: R28 · Bookbinding

checkpoints.zh: 看清各书帖的书脊标记

checkpoints.en: Bind the marked signatures in order
Restore the page panels in the rack
checkpoints.zh: 还原书页板的顺序与正反面

checkpoints.en: Obtain the page panel from the flat file
checkpoints.zh: 从平面抽屉取得缺失书页板

checkpoints.en: Unlock the exit with the obtained code
checkpoints.zh: 用实际获得的密码解锁出口

observations.zh: 看清各书帖的书脊标记

text.en: The exit lock has released; the door can be opened.
text.zh: 出口锁已释放，门还可以打开。

text.en: The marks on the folded signatures form a continuous spine pattern when arranged in the binding jig.
text.zh: 书帖放入装订夹具后，书脊标记应当连成连续图案。

text.en: The guide booklet identifies the flat-file drawer containing the missing page panel.
text.zh: 指导册标出了缺失书页板所在的平面抽屉。

text.en: The marked flat-file drawer contains the remaining double-page panel.
text.zh: 标记的平面抽屉里有缺少的跨页板。

text.en: Compare the panel edges and printed faces with the sample bound book; a panel can be turned over after it is placed in the rack.
text.zh: 比较书页板边缘、印刷面与装订样本；书页板放入架内后还可以翻面。

text.en: The guide booklet's page hops start at the triangle page on the restored rack; compare the pages' corner marks.
text.zh: 指导册的翻页关系从还原书架的三角形页开始；比较各页角部标记。

H2-06.evidence_rules: Only actual game state/events and qualified frames delivered to the model; no standard-solution-order requirement or inferred unread clue.

H2-07.title: R29 · Instrument calibration

checkpoints.en: Inspect the symbol gauges at rest
checkpoints.zh: 看清符号压力表的空载读数
打开调平后释放的仪表盒

checkpoints.en: Unlock the exit with the obtained code
checkpoints.zh: 用实际获得的密码解锁出口

observations.en: Inspect the symbol gauges at rest
observations.zh: 看清符号压力表的空载读数

text.en: The exit lock has released; the door can be opened.
text.zh: 出口锁已释放，门还可以打开。

text.en: Watch the plumb indicator while adjusting the separate support wheels; each wheel changes the base tilt.
text.zh: 分别调整支脚轮并观察铅垂指示；每只轮都会改变底座倾斜。

text.en: The leveled base releases the gauge-case lid.
text.zh: 底座调平后，仪表盒盖已释放。

text.en: The opened gauge case contains the T-shaped valve key.
text.zh: 打开的仪表盒里有T形阀门钥匙。

text.en: The supply-valve spindle has a socket matching the T-shaped key.
text.zh: 供给阀轴上的孔口与T形钥匙相配。

text.en: Trace the work, vent, and bypass branches on the valve diagram before setting the valves.
text.zh: 先沿阀路图追踪工作、排放与旁路分支，再设置阀门。

text.en: Compare each symbol's drum reading with the same symbol's empty gauge; the keypad plate shows their relation.
text.zh: 把各符号的转鼓读数与相同符号的空载表读数比较，键盘牌给出两者关系。

H2-07.evidence_rules: Only actual game state/events and qualified frames delivered to the model; no standard-solution-order requirement or inferred unread clue.

H2-08.title: R30 · Dated records

checkpoints.en: Inspect the beam and case reference marks
checkpoints.zh: 看清横梁与盒子的参照标记
看清记录柜内显露的格图

checkpoints.en: Reveal the calendar through the filter
Unlock the exit with the obtained code
checkpoints.zh: 用实际获得的密码解锁出口

observations.en: Inspect the beam and case reference marks
observations.zh: 看清横梁与盒子的参照标记
看清记录柜内显露的格图

text.en: The exit lock has released; the door can be opened.
text.zh: 出口锁已释放，门还可以打开。

text.en: Compare the pips on the weights with the hook distances on the beam; both weight and position affect its balance.
text.zh: 比较砝码圆点与横梁钩位距离；重量和位置都会影响平衡。

text.en: The balanced beam opens the film case containing the red filter.
text.zh: 横梁平衡后，装红色滤片的盒子已打开。

text.en: The red filter fits the calendar card frame.
text.zh: 红色滤片与日历卡框相配。

text.en: The filtered calendar and nearby reference explain where the notched bars should line up.
text.zh: 加滤片后的日历与旁边参照说明了缺口条应如何对齐。

text.en: The aligned bars release the records-cabinet door.
text.zh: 缺口条对齐后，记录柜门已释放。

text.en: The filtered calendar gives each symbol's day column; compare it with the matching symbol row in the opened record grid.
text.zh: 加滤片后的日历给出各符号的日期列，把它与记录格里相同符号的行对应。

H2-08.evidence_rules: Only actual game state/events and qualified frames delivered to the model; no standard-solution-order requirement or inferred unread clue.

H2-09.title: R31 · Split numerals

checkpoints.zh: 看清叠合后的数字薄片

checkpoints.en: Drive the gears to release a film
Mount both films in the backlit frame
checkpoints.zh: 把两张薄片装入背光框

checkpoints.en: Unlock the exit with the obtained code
checkpoints.zh: 用实际获得的密码解锁出口

observations.zh: 看清叠合后的数字薄片

text.en: The exit lock has released; the door can be opened.
text.zh: 出口锁已释放，门还可以打开。

text.en: Compare the gear sizes with the two empty axles and test the connected train using the crank.
text.zh: 比较齿轮大小与两个空轴位，再用摇柄测试连通的传动。

text.en: The working gear train releases the first numeral film.
text.zh: 齿轮传动成功后，第一张数字薄片已释放。

text.en: The pin lock model shows the relation between the cut knobs and the plug handle.
text.zh: 销锁模型展示了切口旋钮与插芯柄之间的关系。

text.en: The released plug frees the glass door of the second film case.
text.zh: 插芯释放后，第二张薄片的玻璃盒门已释放。

text.en: Place both numeral films in the backlit frame, then compare their line continuations while turning the two film knobs.
text.zh: 把两张数字薄片装入背光框，再转动各自旋钮并比较线条衔接。

text.en: Compare the red corners of both films with the backlit frame's red corner and inspect the completed strokes.
text.zh: 比较两张薄片与背光框的红色角标，检查叠合后完整的笔画。

H2-09.evidence_rules: Only actual game state/events and qualified frames delivered to the model; no standard-solution-order requirement or inferred unread clue.

H2-10.title: R32 · Postal wheel

checkpoints.zh: 看清转轮柜内显露的参照

checkpoints.en: Sort parcels into the marked chutes
Send the token to its destination
Load the token into the conveyor inlet
Unlock the exit with the obtained code
checkpoints.zh: 用实际获得的密码解锁出口

observations.zh: 看清转轮柜内显露的参照

text.en: The exit lock has released; the door can be opened.
text.zh: 出口锁已释放，门还可以打开。

text.en: The sample envelope shows the required print; adjust the franking wheels and use the lever to compare an actual impression.
text.zh: 样本信封给出邮戳参照；调整转轮后，用压杆查看实际印痕。

text.en: Use the sorting card to compare the parcels' glass and orientation marks with the chute signs.
text.zh: 依据分拣卡，比较包裹的玻璃与朝向标记和各投入口标志。

text.en: The completed parcel sorting releases a brass destination token.
text.zh: 包裹分拣完成后，黄铜目的地筹码已释放。

text.en: The token's destination and the conveyor flap diagram describe one route from the inlet to a collection bin.
text.zh: 筹码目的地与传送挡板图共同描述了从入口到收集格的路线。

text.en: Delivery to the matching bin releases the wheel-cabinet door.
text.zh: 送达对应收集格后，转轮柜门已释放。

text.en: The punched card and number ring share a triangle reference; compare the punched offsets from that mark.
text.zh: 打孔卡与数字环共用三角形参照，从该标记比较各孔的偏移。

H2-11.title: R33 · Filling repair

checkpoints.en: Match the sealed bottles to the cradles
Restore water flow through the repaired line
Replace old samples with fresh samples
Obtain the hose and repair collar
Fit the collar over the cracked riser
checkpoints.zh: 将修补环用于开裂立管

checkpoints.en: Fit the hose to the vent port
Unlock the exit with the obtained code
checkpoints.zh: 用实际获得的密码解锁出口

text.en: The exit lock has released; the door can be opened.
text.zh: 出口锁已释放，门还可以打开。

text.en: Compare each bottle's seal and level with the placement rule beside the cradles.
text.zh: 比较各瓶的封口与液位特征和支架旁的摆放规则。

text.en: The matched bottle arrangement releases the tool-case door.
text.zh: 瓶具摆放匹配后，工具柜门已释放。

text.en: The repair picture links the collar to the cracked riser and the hose to the vent; then check the valve.
text.zh: 维修图把修补环与开裂立管、软管与通气口对应起来；随后检查阀门。

text.en: The drain taps empty the old contents; the sample-fill tap works through the repaired line.
text.zh: 排水旋钮用于排出旧内容物，样本注入龙头通过修复后的管线工作。

text.en: The lit bottle bench and fresh sample columns use the same seal symbols; the keypad plate relates the two readings.
text.zh: 点亮的瓶具台与新样本柱使用相同封印符号，键盘牌说明两种读数的关系。

H2-11.evidence_rules: Only actual game state/events and qualified frames delivered to the model; no standard-solution-order requirement or inferred unread clue.

H2-12.title: R34 · Low-voltage interlock

checkpoints.en: Inspect the wiring and target picture
Inspect the reference inside the reading cabinet
Inspect the lamp-state card inside the holding box
checkpoints.zh: 看清固定盒内的灯状态卡

checkpoints.en: Slack the lid claw with the winch
Fit the two drive blocks in their corresponding sockets
checkpoints.zh: 将两块传动块装入相配插座

checkpoints.en: Unlock the exit with the obtained code
checkpoints.zh: 用实际获得的密码解锁出口

observations.en: Inspect the wiring and target picture
Inspect the reference inside the reading cabinet
Inspect the lamp-state card inside the holding box
observations.zh: 看清固定盒内的灯状态卡

text.en: The exit lock has released; the door can be opened.
text.zh: 出口锁已释放，门还可以打开。

text.en: Compare the coloured toggles with the wiring picture and the target lamp condition.
text.zh: 比较彩色开关、接线图与目标灯状态。

text.en: The completed circuit releases a flat bar.
text.zh: 电路条件满足后，一根释放扁杆已可取得。

text.en: The winch changes the tension on the lid claw; compare the released bar with the claw slot.
text.zh: 绞盘改变盖爪张力；比较释放扁杆与爪上的槽口。

text.en: Compare the drive directions printed on the two blocks with the socket diagram and bypass clutch before turning the input crank.
text.zh: 转动输入摇柄前，比较两块传动块标出的方向、插座示意和旁路离合。

text.en: The working interlock releases the reading-cabinet door.
text.zh: 互锁传动成功后，读数柜门已释放。

text.en: Match the seal lamps on the holding-box card with their corresponding rows in the reading-cabinet table.
text.zh: 把固定盒卡片上的封印灯状态与读数柜表内对应的行匹配。

H2-13.title: R35 · Screen inspection

checkpoints.zh: 看清遮盖片的不同固定方式
看清装入并照亮的样本
看清样本对应数字参照
看清解除遮盖后显露的底网

checkpoints.en: Mount the sample in the light box
Unlock the exit with the obtained code
checkpoints.zh: 用实际获得的密码解锁出口

observations.zh: 看清遮盖片的不同固定方式
看清装入并照亮的样本
看清样本对应数字参照
看清解除遮盖后显露的底网

text.en: The exit lock has released; the door can be opened.
text.zh: 出口锁已释放，门还可以打开。

text.en: The cover sheets use different fasteners; match the pliers and screwdriver to what is holding each sheet.
text.zh: 各遮盖片的固定方式不同，把钳子、螺丝刀与相应固定件匹配。

text.en: Compare the two thin wedges with the slots at the two sides of the press jaws.
text.zh: 比较两片薄楔与压钳两侧的槽口。

text.en: The supported jaws expose the sample sheet.
text.zh: 压钳撑开后，样本片已露出。

text.en: The sample fits the light-box mount; its pattern becomes useful with the back light switched on.
text.zh: 样本与灯箱安装位相配，打开背光后才能利用其图案。

text.en: Compare the exposed bottom mesh with the real holes revealed by the backlit sample and the number grid.
text.zh: 把显露的底网与背光样本揭示的真实孔位及数字格比较。

H2-14.title: R36 · Before and after storage

checkpoints.zh: 看清箱体移动印记参照
